absent.detail: MBT_IB_PAPER_CLIENT_ID is unset or empty. Set it in .env, copying the shape from .env.example. This repository holds no default for it, because a default account number or a default port is how a session ends up somewhere nobody chose.

median_bps.detail: no observations, so the 50% percentile is absent and is never reported as zero or as nan.

p90_bps.detail: no observations, so the 90% percentile is absent and is never reported as zero or as nan.

reason: no session, so no window was appended. A missed window is a gap in a discrete sample and is recorded as one, never backfilled.
